question.text: The 2023 cross-sectional CSO Coalition@75 study cited in Ch 1.1 (Box 1) found that Indian NPOs primarily contribute to which SDGs?

answer.text: Only SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water)
Education, health, gender equality, and poverty reduction

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 1.1 Box 1, the 2023 cross-sectional study of 851 NPOs found that NPOs primarily contribute to SDGs related to education, health, gender equality, and poverty reduction. 70% focus on social services, 59% on education, 56% on employment & community development. The Trap: Options A, C and D narrow to single SDGs that are not the primary focus area per the survey. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Ch 8 (Case Studies). Knowing the NPO sectoral mix helps SIAs benchmark the engaged SE against peer density.
